references.title: BIR RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(f) as amended by RR 11-2018: actual medical assistance is de minimis to PHP10,000 a year; the excess is an 'other benefit' within the PHP90,000 exclusion.

description: Reimburses a medical bill to the employee, at the amount entered. With other medical assistance it is tax-free up to ₱10,000 a year; anything above counts toward the ₱90,000 yearly limit (RR 2-98 s.2.78.1(A)(3)(f)).
